title: Early idols: Kid Ory's band, Johnny Dodds, and taking up saxophone
summary: He heard Ory's band with Dodds as a boy, names clarinet favourites, and says when he took up the saxophones.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Like I was in your early days when you were first starting up playing. Yeah. The guys you used to listen to most. Oh. Have perhaps influenced you? Many. The guys from the Kings. Particularly Clare. Well, I tell you. When I was a kid, 14 years old in New Orleans, I used to go up on Sundays to hear Kid Orris Band. He was playing at Miss Coors Lawn. It was a penny party in those days for the kids, you know.

And I used to go up on Sundays to hear Kid Orris Band. And he was playing at Miss Coors Lawn. 10 o'clock at night. And Johnny Dodds was playing with Orris and he really amazed me. He was my idol at the time. Johnny Dodds gave me a lot of enthusiasm, you know. Enthusiasm. Yeah. Yeah. And of course you had all-fine musicians at that time. afternoons until 10 o'clock at night. And Johnny Dodds was playing with Ori and he really amazed me. He was my idol at the time. Johnny Dodds gave me a lot of enthusiasm, you know? And of course you had all fine musicians at that time. Big guy, Louis Nelson was in his prime, young man playing plenty of horn. Picou was in his prime. Teo was in his prime. George Baquette was one of the finest too. Great, great clarinetist. And a few others. So I had all those guys to listen to and influence me. When did you take up saxophone? I had taken up saxophone around 1921 in New Orleans. I was playing at Anderson's as I said. And Bonnie took up tenor and I took up alto. And two of the years I've played all the saxes. I've played alto with King Oliver and tenor in China. Came back to America and played alto with Louis Ross's band for a year or so. Then they switched me on tenor, first tenor. I played baritone and doing all the clarinet work. You played all the saxes?
